section.content: The present invention provides a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit of the power consumption for suppressing semiconductor integrated circuit.In the semiconductor integrated circuit, possess：The 1st path P 1 of data processing is performed by data processing circuit (horizontal filter 10)；With bypass data processing circuit (horizontal filter 10) or carry out by simplified circuit (delay circuit 20) the 2nd path P 2 of data processing.And, semiconductor integrated circuit exclusively selects the 1st path and the 2nd path according to pattern, and stops to the circuit input data without selected path.Thus power consumption is suppressed.
